run_math_qa_preprocessing: run the MathQA dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_math_qa_dataset: create a MathQA dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace math_qa dataset for text-to-text tasks
process_math_qa_line: process a single MathQA datapoint to extract lettered choices and the correct answer
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace MathQA dataset split to a list of problem-choice tuples with answers
load_math_qa_dataset: load the math_qa dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
